name: Darkcasting spawns a Blood Orb on a critical strike (#3042)
contract: Darkcasting 706247 reads 'Critical strikes with abilities now spawn a Blood Orb near you for $707434d'. Its single effect is aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Blood Orb 707434, a stock SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON of creature 315303 (MiscValueB 61, TargetA 18, radius index 193, duration index 8). Spell.dbc gives 706247 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it and no orb was ever summoned. 706247's AuraDescription describes a different effect entirely (Sanguine Rupture and Claw Sweep cooldowns); the Description and the single effect agree with each other and are what this scenario holds the spell to. Bloodbolt is cast as rank 578305 (the rank a level-80 character owns; 578304 is only granted up to level 52 and gets no server response) and spell_crit_rating 100000 makes the critical strike deterministic instead of hoping for one.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Darkcasting passive is active
Blood Orbs owned before the cast
DISCRIMINATING: a critical Bloodbolt spawns a Blood Orb 315303
